note: X-150/X-151. Every launch dimension x every launch door, measured by CALLING each door with every dimension set and seeing what it hands on. Each cell is carried, exempt:<reason> or gap:<reason>. An exemption is declared in the door module itself, beside the code its reason is about - never here. gapBudget MAY ONLY BE LOWERED: raising it means a door stopped carrying something, which is the failure this counts. Reseed: node test/test_launch_matrix.js --fix

profile.account: exempt: X-169 - a profile is a SETUP and an account is a STATE. Stored, it would pin a saved launch to a plan that may be exhausted by the time anybody presses it, and it would outrank the use-this-next gesture the same way a per-agent memory would - which is the decision that item took. A launch from a profile still runs on the resolved account; it is simply not the profile that answers.
